records.answer:
Apple 已同意以最高 95 美元/台、總額約 2.5 億美元的和解金，解決因宣稱未實際存在的「增強 Siri 功能」而對 iPhone 用戶的誤導指控【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

- 這筆和解金額上限為 250 百萬美元，若獲法院批准，將成為 Apple 最大的和解案之一【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 和解適用於在 2024 年 6 月 10 日至 2025 年 3 月 29 日期間購買 iPhone 16、iPhone 15 Pro 或 iPhone 15 Pro Max 的用戶，約有 3,700 萬部 iPhone 符合資格【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 符合條件的消費者最初可獲得每部手機 25 美元，最終金額視申請情況而定，最高不超過 95 美元/部【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。

iPhone owners could receive up to $95 under a proposed $250 million settlement resolving claims that Apple misled customers about Siri's artificial intelligence features, according to a recent court filing. The class-action lawsuit, filed in federal court in the Northern District of California on behalf of U.S. consumers, claims that Apple deceived customers by marketing "Enhanced Siri features" that did not yet exist, leading them to buy iPhones based on false advertising. The plaintiffs are seeking a $250 million settlement payment, according to a recent court filing. If approved by a judge, it could rank among the largest settlements involving Apple. "Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features," an Apple spokesperson said in an email to CBS News. "We resolved this matter to stay focused on doing what we do best, delivering the most innovative products and services to our users."
Clarkson Law Firm, a public interest law firm that filed the original lawsuit against Apple, said in a statement on Wednesday that the settlement would provide "timely relief to tens of millions of consumers nationwide."
Here's what to know about the recent settlement. Am I eligible? The settlement covers people who purchased an iPhone 16 model, iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025. Approximately 37 million iPhone owners are eligible, according to the court filing. Customers will be notified by either email or mail if they can file a claim. An online social media campaign will also provide information about the settlement website and who is eligible, according to the court filing. How much money could I get? Eligible customers will initially receive $25 per device. Depending on how many claims are submitted and other determining factors, the final payment may increase or decrease, but it will not exceed $95 per device, according to the court filing
How do I file a claim? Claim filing details are not released yet. Clarkson Law Firm said on its
website
that a settlement website with more details will be available in "a few weeks."
According to the court filing, the website "will include all necessary information to learn about the settlement" and a number consumers can call with questions. Edited by

records.answer:
Apple 在本次 WWDC 上宣布，將於今年秋季以 beta 形式在美國英語市場首次推出全新 AI 版 Siri（Siri AI）【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】【AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2】。

- Siri AI 能夠直接從使用者的應用程式中提取上下文，讓使用者只要說出需求（例如要找妹妹推薦的播客）就能在不開啟其他 App 的情況下呈現內容【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 這項功能是以 Google 的 Gemini 系列模型（包括 Gemini Flash‑Lite、Flash、Pro 以及 Image 模型）為核心，同時結合 Apple 自家研發的 Apple Frontier Models（AFM），後者先以專有資料與強化學習訓練，再以 Google Gemini Frontier 模型的輸出進行微調【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 為了在不泄露使用者資料的前提下提供足夠算力，Apple 透過 Private Cloud Compute（私有雲運算）在自有伺服器上處理 AI 請求，並與 Nvidia 合作，將這些工作負載搬移至 Nvidia 晶片支援的 Google 雲端，Apple 亦是唯一能在這些 Nvidia‑powered Google 伺服器上部署軟體的公司【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #1】。  
- Siri AI 會整合進 Apple Intelligence，未來將影響 Safari 瀏覽器以及 Password、Messages 等應用程式的功能【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 同時，WWDC 也展示了 iOS 的視覺升級與加強的家長控制功能，顯示 Apple 正在以 AI 為驅動力提升整體生態系統體驗【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 市場方面，Evercore ISI 已將 Apple 股價目標從 $330 提升至 $365，維持「Outperform」評等，反映分析師對 AI 推動的成長前景持正面看法【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。

During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. records.query: NVIDIA 最近跟 IREN 之間有什麼合作的新聞？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 最近與 IREN 簽署了一份多層次的合作協議，核心包括一份價值 **34 億美元的五年 AI Cloud 服務合約** 以及一筆 **21 億美元的投資承諾**，投資金額會隨 IREN 部署 NVIDIA GPU 而逐步解鎖【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

- **AI Cloud 合約**：IREN 與 NVIDIA 簽訂了五年 34 億美元的 AI Cloud 合約，主要針對空冷 Blackwell GPU，已在 Childress 佈署約 60 MW 的容量，合約中約有 7 億美元的 ARR 與此 60 MW 相關，預計在 2026‑2027 年間逐步擴大【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
- **投資結構**：NVIDIA 同意投入 21 億美元，投資權益僅在 IREN 部署 NVIDIA GPU 基礎設施時逐步解鎖，全部投資金額在部署 **60 萬顆 GPU** 後才會完全生效【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **股權購買權**：此外，NVIDIA 獲得一項五年期的購股權，可以每股 70 美元的價格購買最多 3000 萬股 IREN 普通股，若全部行使，最高可帶來 21 億美元的潛在投資額【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- **部署與產能目標**：IREN 計畫在 2026 年完成 **480 MW** 的 AI Cloud 容量，部署約 **150,000 顆 GPU**，並在 2027 年擴展至 **1,210 MW**（其中 730 MW 正在建設中）【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **財務影響**：在最新的財季（截至 2026 年 3 月）中，IREN 的 AI Cloud 服務收入升至 **3,360 萬美元**（較前季的 1,730 萬美元增長），而比特幣挖礦收入則下降至 **1.112 億美元**，顯示業務正快速向 AI Cloud 轉型【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  

總結來說，NVIDIA 與 IREN 的合作涵蓋了大型 AI Cloud 服務合約、與 GPU 部署掛鉤的股權投資，以及未來可能的股權購買權，並伴隨著 IREN 大幅擴張 AI 計算容量的具體建設計畫。

最近，Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 表示，中國對高階 AI 晶片的限制將會「逐步」放寬，但目前仍受多項禁令與市場不確定性限制【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0】。

- Huang 在接受 Bloomberg 采訪時說，他預期中國最終會向能訓練與運行 AI 系統的高端美國晶片開放市場，並指出「隨著時間推移，市場會開放」【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 目前最先進的 H200 晶片此前因美國國安考量被禁止在中國銷售，且尚未看到中國科技公司實際購買的跡象，因中國正加速自行研發晶片以挑戰美國主導地位【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 雖然 H200 已取得「可向中國授權銷售」的許可，但仍未正式在中國市場流通，且 Nvidia 最高階的 Blackwell 與即將推出的 Rubin 系列仍被全面禁止銷售【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 美國總統特朗普在去年底稱已與中國領導人達成協議，放寬對 H200 晶片的限制，但此舉也引發美國部分立法者擔憂可能助長中國軍事應用【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 中國國家領導人習近平在與美國商界代表會面時表示，中國將「更大程度」向世界開放，暗示未來可能進一步放寬相關限制【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。  

總結來說，Nvidia 正在觀察中國市場的逐步開放，H200 晶片已獲得授權但仍未見實際銷售，而更高階的 Blackwell 與 Rubin 系列仍被禁，未來的市場機會仍取決於雙方政策與安全審查的進一步發展。

China market for Nvidia AI chips to open 'over time': Huang
AFP
Tue, May 19, 2026 at 11:02 AM GMT+8
2 min read
NVDA
-1.33%
Nvidia boss Jensen Huang expects China to eventually open its market to high-end US chips that can train and run artificial intelligence systems. But he did not discuss sales of the powerful H200 model with top officials in Beijing, the businessman told Bloomberg Television in an interview broadcast Monday. Huang travelled to the country last week with US President Donald Trump, who met Chinese President Xi Jinping. The superpowers are in a fierce race for AI supremacy, and the H200 chip had until recently been barred from sale in China by Washington over national security concerns. However, there is no sign that Chinese tech companies are buying them, as Beijing ramps up domestic chip development in a bid to challenge US dominance in the key sector. "H200s are licensed to sell to China.

[NVDA] But the Chinese government has to decide how much of their local market do they want to protect," Huang said. "My sense is that over time the market will open," added Huang, CEO of Nvidia -- the world's most valuable company, due to huge demand for its AI hardware. Trump said in December he had reached an agreement with Xi to ease the restrictions on H200 chips, a move some US lawmakers have warned could help the Chinese military. Nvidia's most top-of-the-range offerings, the Blackwell and forthcoming Rubin series, remain banned for sale in China. Xi told a delegation of US business executives on Thursday that China would "open wider" to the world.

- **競爭對手**  
  - **Cerebras**：剛完成 IPO，推出與 Nvidia 不同的 AI 處理器，聲稱在整體效能上更快【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
  - **AMD**：預計在今年稍後推出競爭性的機架式伺服器系統【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
  - **Amazon (AMZN)**：已將自家 AI 晶片業務擴展為年收入跑道超過 **200 億美元**，且以 **三位數的年增長率** 擴張【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
  - **Google (GOOG/GOOGL)**：同樣向第三方客戶提供自家 AI 晶片，與 Nvidia 形成直接競爭【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。

- **市場焦點**  
  - **AI 晶片市場**：Nvidia 被視為 AI 交易的晴雨表，因其業績被認為是人工智慧熱潮的關鍵指標【NVDA_News_20260519_02.txt, chunk #1】。  
  - **中國市場**：報導提及 Nvidia 正在面對「中國困境」，暗示地緣政治或供應鏈因素可能影響其在華業務【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
  - **AI 產業整體增長**：整個 S&P 500 正在呈現雙位數盈餘增長，半導體公司（包括 Nvidia）則顯示 AI 爆發仍是主要驅動力【NVDA_News_20260519_02.txt, chunk #1】。  

因此，新聞在財報前的關注點集中於上述競爭者的挑戰、Amazon 與 Google 逐步自建 AI 晶片生態，以及 AI 市場的高速成長與中國市場的不確定性。

records.answer:
Apple 的服務業務被新聞形容為「雙位數成長且高利潤」的核心驅動力，直接提升了公司的整體毛利與現金回報能力。  

- 服務營收佔總收入約 28%，上季創下 310 億美元的紀錄，較去年同期增長 16%【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- 服務收入的快速增長被視為提升毛利率的主要因素，Apple 的 TTM 毛利率已升至 47.9%，僅次於 SNDK 的 56.0%，其中服務高毛利佔了重要貢獻【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
- 受益於服務的高利潤貢獻，Apple 的 EBITDA 利潤率達 35.4%，在同業中僅次於 SNDK；槓桿自由現金流利潤率為 22.4%，領跑所有比較對象【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
- 股東回報方面，Apple 產生的自由現金流（TTM）為 1292 億美元，遠高於同業，顯示服務部門的現金產出能力極強【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
- 看漲觀點認為，隨著 25 億+ 裝置基礎的持續貨幣化，服務部門未來有望保持超過 14% 的年增長，並將公司毛利率推升至 48% 以上，進一步支撐高估值【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2】。  

總結來說，新聞一致認為 Apple 的服務業務正以兩位數的增速擴張，同時因其高毛利特性成為提升公司整體獲利能力與現金回流的關鍵引擎。

Operating margin now sits at 32.6%, and the company throws off $129.2 billion in free cash flow on a TTM basis. That FCF easily covers the $7.7 billion in dividends and $37.0 billion in buybacks Apple executed in the first half of FY 2026. The balance sheet is fortress-grade. Apple holds $146.6 billion in cash and marketable securities against $82.7 billion in term debt. Net cash position is positive and growing. Valuation
Source: Seeking Alpha

Seagate Technology (STX)
. On forward P/E, Apple sits at 33.5x versus
Sandisk (SNDK)
at 24.2x,

at 29.7x, and

at just 22.2x. Price-to-cash-flow tells a similar story. Apple commands 30.7x, well above Dell’s 14.4x but cheaper than WDC and STX. The market is paying up for Apple’s Services mix, capital returns, and brand moat. Whether that’s justified is the central question. Growth
Source: Seeking Alpha
Here’s where the premium gets harder to defend. Apple’s 12.8% YoY revenue growth trails SNDK’s 82.8% surge, WDC’s 32.0%, and STX’s 28.9%. Forward revenue growth of 9.6% is the weakest in the group except WDC. Yet Apple’s three-year revenue CAGR of 5.4% beats WDC and SNDK, both of whom posted negative numbers over that stretch. The hardware peers are riding an AI-driven storage upcycle. Apple is the steadier compounder. Profitability
Source: Seeking Alpha
This is Apple’s home turf. Apple’s 47.9% gross margin trails only SNDK’s 56.0%. EBITDA margin of 35.4% beats every peer except SNDK. Levered FCF margin of 22.4% leads the group. Return on common equity of 141.5% dwarfs everyone except STX, which benefits from a tiny equity base. Most striking: Apple generated $140.2 billion in cash from operations on a TTM basis. The next closest, Dell, did $11.2 billion. Continued…
Our Opinion 7/10
Apple’s quarter was a genuine surprise to the upside, and the company’s cash generation remains in a league of its own. The dividend hike and fresh $100 billion buyback give investors a tangible return floor. But the stock isn’t cheap. At 33.5x forward earnings with sub-10% forward revenue growth, you’re paying a quality premium that leaves little room for an iPhone stumble or a tariff escalation. For long-term holders, Apple stays a core position.

[AAPL] The Board authorized another $100 billion buyback and raised the dividend 4%. Search volume from financial pros spiked, with Apple drawing nearly 21,000 searches in the past month, per our TrackStar data, more than its next four hardware peers combined. So is the run sustainable, or did Apple just front-load demand ahead of more tariff drama? Apple’s Business
Apple needs no introduction, but the company’s transformation does. What was once a hardware story is now a hybrid: $80.2 billion in product sales last quarter alongside $31.0 billion in high-margin services. The installed base of active devices hit another all-time high across every product category and every geography. Apple sells iPhones, Macs, iPads, wearables, and a growing suite of subscription services to roughly a billion paying users globally. Apple segments its business into the following areas:
iPhone (51% of total revenues)
– Flagship smartphone line, recently expanded with the iPhone 17 lineup and a new iPhone 17e
Services (28% of total revenues)
– App Store, advertising, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV+, and payment services
Mac (8% of total revenues)
– Laptops and desktops, including the newly launched MacBook Neo
Wearables, Home & Accessories (7% of total revenues)
– AirPods, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and accessories
iPad (6% of total revenues)
– Tablet lineup, recently refreshed with the M4-powered iPad Air
iPhone revenue jumped 22% to $57.0 billion, the standout of the quarter. Services climbed 16% to a record $31.0 billion, propelled by advertising, App Store, and cloud. Greater China rebounded sharply, with renminbi strength adding fuel. Tim Cook called demand for the iPhone 17 lineup “extraordinary.”
On the strategic front, Apple is going all-in on AI infrastructure. R&D spending jumped 34% year-over-year to $11.4 billion last quarter, citing higher infrastructure costs. Tariff overhang remains real but manageable. A February Supreme Court ruling struck down certain tariffs, and Apple is applying for refunds. The company also flagged that semiconductor, NAND, and DRAM supply constraints could pressure costs into the next quarter. Story Continues
Financials
Source: Stock Analysis
Apple’s trailing twelve-month revenue hit $451.4 billion, up 12.8% year-over-year, the strongest growth rate since FY 2021’s post-pandemic surge. Gross margins continue to climb.

China market for Nvidia AI chips to open 'over time': Huang
AFP
Tue, May 19, 2026 at 11:02 AM GMT+8
2 min read
NVDA
-1.33%
Nvidia boss Jensen Huang expects China to eventually open its market to high-end US chips that can train and run artificial intelligence systems. But he did not discuss sales of the powerful H200 model with top officials in Beijing, the businessman told Bloomberg Television in an interview broadcast Monday. Huang travelled to the country last week with US President Donald Trump, who met Chinese President Xi Jinping. The superpowers are in a fierce race for AI supremacy, and the H200 chip had until recently been barred from sale in China by Washington over national security concerns. However, there is no sign that Chinese tech companies are buying them, as Beijing ramps up domestic chip development in a bid to challenge US dominance in the key sector. "H200s are licensed to sell to China.

[NVDA] But the Chinese government has to decide how much of their local market do they want to protect," Huang said. "My sense is that over time the market will open," added Huang, CEO of Nvidia -- the world's most valuable company, due to huge demand for its AI hardware. Trump said in December he had reached an agreement with Xi to ease the restrictions on H200 chips, a move some US lawmakers have warned could help the Chinese military. Nvidia's most top-of-the-range offerings, the Blackwell and forthcoming Rubin series, remain banned for sale in China. Xi told a delegation of US business executives on Thursday that China would "open wider" to the world.

[NVDA] "American companies will enjoy even brighter prospects in China," Xi said, Chinese state media reported. Bloomberg Television asked Huang whether he spoke to Xi and Prime Minister Li Qiang about his chips. "I didn't discuss directly with them about H200" although "President Trump had some conversations with the leaders", he replied. kaf/abs

. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

Microsoft 的營收持續以兩位數的速度成長：2025 財年雲端營收增長 23% 至 1,689 億美元，Azure 服務單季收入更以 39% 的高速成長，Microsoft 365 商務雲端收入在 2025 年第四季提升約 17%（2026 年第一季則達 18%）【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #138】、【MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107】、【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】；同時，生產力與商務流程部門的總營收在 2026 年前九個月較去年同期增長 16%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】。

在新聞層面，Microsoft 在 2026 年 6 月的報導中透露已自行開發七個全新 AI 模型，這標誌著公司從依賴外部前沿實驗室轉向「自行打造」AI 堆疊，並已將大量 GPU 計算資源配置給內部研發團隊，以支援 AI 產品與 Copilot 等服務【MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。此策略顯示 Microsoft 正在：

1. **降低外部模型授權成本**：自研模型可減少對第三方（如 OpenAI）模型的依賴，提升毛利率空間。  
2. **加速 AI 與雲端服務的結合**：Azure 已是 AI 基礎設施的核心，39% 的雲端收入增長與 AI 基礎設施投資相呼應。  
3. **提升每位使用者收入（ARPU）**：Microsoft 365 商務雲端收入增長主要來自 E5 與 Copilot 等高價值功能，顯示 AI 功能正帶動使用者付費升級。  
4. **強化長期競爭壁壘**：自行擁有模型與算力平台，使 Microsoft 能在 AI 應用、生產力套件與雲端服務間形成更緊密的生態系，提升客戶黏著度。

綜合營收成長與自研 AI 模型的雙重驅動，Microsoft 正在以高速增長的雲端與 AI 產品為核心，打造以自有 AI 堆疊為支撐的長期競爭優勢。

By Juby Babu
May 18 (Reuters) - Anthropic said on Monday it is revising its earlier position to allow users of its Mythos cybersecurity model ‌to share information about cyber threats with others who may be exposed ‌to similar vulnerabilities. Mythos, announced on April 7, is being deployed as part of Anthropic's "Project Glasswing," a controlled ​initiative under which select organizations, including major tech firms such as Amazon,
Microsoft
,
Nvidia
and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. Mythos' capabilities to code at a high level have given it a potentially ‌unprecedented ability to identify cybersecurity ⁠vulnerabilities and devise ways to exploit them, according to experts. Last week, Anthropic began telling partners that they are generally permitted to disclose ⁠their involvement in Glasswing and, at their own discretion, share findings, best practices, tools or code developed through the program. "We fully support our partners sharing findings with each ​other and ​companies outside of Glasswing to triage vulnerabilities," ​an Anthropic spokesperson said in a ‌statement. "While there was never a specific Glasswing NDA, confidentiality protections were something partners asked for at the outset and were built into agreements partners signed."
The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. "As the program has matured, we've adapted them ​to ensure key information can be shared broadly - ​including outside the program - for maximum ​defensive impact," the spokesperson added.

records.answer:
Tesla’s automotive gross margin has improved on a year‑to‑date basis but slipped a few‑tenths of a percentage point in the most recent quarter, and the broader “Magnificent Seven” sell‑off has dragged Tesla’s share price down together with the other mega‑tech stocks.  

**Automotive margin trend**  
- In Q2 2026 the automotive segment generated $20,516 million of revenue and incurred $17,053 million of cost of revenues, giving an automotive gross profit of $3,463 million and a gross margin of roughly 16.9 % (3,463 ÷ 20,516) [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0].  
- In Q2 2025 the same segment recorded $16,661 million of revenue and $13,795 million of cost of revenues, yielding an automotive gross profit of $2,866 million and a margin of about 17.2 % (2,866 ÷ 16,661) [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0].  
- On a year‑to‑date (YTD) basis, automotive revenue rose to $36,750 million in 2026 versus $30,628 million in 2025, while automotive cost of revenues rose to $29,865 million versus $25,495 million, producing a YTD gross profit of $6,885 million and a margin of roughly 18.7 % (6,885 ÷ 36,750) compared with 16.8 % (5,133 ÷ 30,628) a year earlier [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0].  
- **Trend:** The YTD automotive margin has risen from about 16.8 % to 18.7 %, indicating an improving cost‑to‑revenue profile, while the latest quarter’s margin slipped from 17.2 % to 16.9 %, a modest quarter‑over‑quarter decline.

**Implication of the Magnificent Seven sell‑off**  
- A Reuters‑cited JPMorgan note reported that “Shares in the ‘Magnificent Seven’ … have all declined since last Friday,” and the Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF fell more than 2.4 % since June 5 [NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0].  
- Because Tesla is listed as one of the Magnificent Seven, the statement that “all declined” implies Tesla’s stock also fell during that period [NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0].  

**What this suggests for Tesla’s stock**  
- The automotive margin improvement shows underlying operational strength, but the simultaneous broad‑based tech sell‑off, which includes Tesla, indicates that market sentiment and risk‑off behavior can suppress Tesla’s share price even when its core margin metrics are trending positively.  No specific price figure is provided in the filings, so the inference is limited to the observed co‑movement with the Magnificent Seven index.

records.query: NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心護城河在於它提供的完整、緊密耦合的硬體‑軟體平台——以 CUDA 為核心的 GPU 生態系統結合自家 CPU、DPU、網路與雲端系統，以及廣泛的軟體庫、框架與 AI 服務，形成高網路效應與切換成本的優勢。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]  

- **硬體領先**：NVIDIA 同時提供 AI 伺服器所需的三大處理單元——GPU、CPU（Grace）與 DPU，並將這些晶片與高速互連、系統與散熱設計整合成資料中心規模的解決方案，讓客戶可以在單一平台上完成訓練與推論工作負載。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]、[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]  

- **軟體堆疊**：公司以 CUDA 為基礎，建置了包括 NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints 以及 NVIDIA AI Enterprise 在內的完整軟體套件，這些工具可簡化生成式 AI 應用的開發、部署與安全管理，並在所有 NVIDIA 硬體上提供一致的開發體驗。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]  

- **開發者與合作夥伴生態**：全球已有超過 750 萬名開發者使用 CUDA 及其他 NVIDIA 軟體工具，並透過 Inception 計畫、Deep Learning Institute 以及與主要伺服器製造商與雲端服務供應商的合作，持續擴大生態系統的規模與黏著度。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]、[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]  

- **研發投入**：自公司成立以來已累積超過 767 億美元的研發支出，這些資金支撐了 GPU、Tensor Core、自家 CPU、以及 AI 軟體平台的持續創新，鞏固了技術領先地位。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]  

- **平台化策略**：NVIDIA 的平台策略將硬體、系統、軟體、演算法、模型與資料集等多層面整合為一體，讓同一套可程式化架構能同時服務多個數十億美元的終端市場，提升了客戶對單一供應商的依賴程度。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]  

這些要素共同構成了 NVIDIA 的技術護城河：深度整合的全棧硬體與軟體、生態系統規模、持續的研發創新以及平台化的商業模式，使得競爭者在短期內難以複製其完整價值鏈，且客戶在轉換供應商時會面臨顯著的技術與成本障礙。

Microsoft 365 Commercial revenue is mainly affected by a combination of continued installed base growth and average revenue per user expansion, as well as the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365. Microsoft 365 Consumer is designed to increase personal productivity and creativity through a range of products and services. Growth depends on our ability to reach new users, add value to our core product set with new features including AI tools, and continue to expand our product and service offerings into new markets. Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue and Office Consumer products revenue is mainly affected by the percentage of customers that buy Office with their new devices and the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions. LinkedIn connects the world’s professionals to make them more productive and successful and transforms the way companies hire, market, sell, and learn. records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft uses Windows as a growth engine that pushes more users onto its cloud platform and its AI‑driven Copilot services by encouraging Windows users to engage with those offerings directly on the OS [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49].

- **Windows fuels the cloud business** – Microsoft explicitly states that it “leverages Windows to fuel our cloud business” [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]. By keeping Windows as the primary desktop and laptop operating system, the company creates a large installed base that can be steered toward Azure‑based workloads and other cloud solutions.  
- **Windows drives higher engagement with Copilot and other services** – The same passage notes that Windows helps “drive increased engagement with our services like … Copilot, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Edge, Bing, Microsoft 365 Consumer, Xbox Game Pass, and more” [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]. This indicates that Microsoft bundles or promotes Copilot‑related features within the Windows experience, prompting users to adopt the AI assistant as part of their everyday workflow.  
- **Strategic focus on AI‑enabled productivity** – Microsoft’s broader 10‑K narrative emphasizes “applying AI and ambient intelligence to drive insights, revolutionize many types of work and business processes, and provide substantive productivity gains using Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents” [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]. While not limited to Windows, this AI push is reinforced by the OS‑level exposure described above.  

In summary, Microsoft’s strategy is to capitalize on Windows’ dominant PC presence to channel users toward its cloud infrastructure and AI‑driven Copilot tools, thereby raising participation rates for those services. [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] For enterprises, digital technology empowers employees, optimizes operations, engages customers, and in some cases, changes the very core of products and services. The Microsoft Cloud provides integration across the technology stack while offering openness, improving time to value, reducing costs, and increasing agility. Our cloud business benefits from three economies of scale: datacenters that deploy computational resources at significantly lower cost per unit than smaller ones; datacenters that coordinate and aggregate diverse customer, geographic, and application demand patterns, improving the utilization of computing, storage, and network resources; and multi-tenancy locations that lower application maintenance labor costs. We prioritize security above all else and we offer our customers integrated AI-driven products addressing security, compliance, identity, management, and privacy across customers’ multi-cloud, application, and device assets. The Ambitions That Drive Us

To achieve our vision, our research and development efforts focus on three interconnected ambitions:

•Reinvent productivity and business processes to help organizations and individuals work and collaborate more securely and efficiently. •Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform to provide a foundation for our customers’ digital workloads including hybrid consistency, developer productivity, data and AI capabilities, and trusted security and compliance. •Create more personal computing to enable users to interact with technology in more intuitive, engaging, and dynamic ways. Our Future Opportunity

We are focused on helping customers use the breadth and depth of the Microsoft Cloud to get the most value out of their digital spend while leading the AI platform wave across our solution areas. We continue to develop complete, intelligent solutions for our customers that empower people to be productive and collaborate, while safeguarding businesses and simplifying IT management. Our goal is to lead the industry in several distinct areas of technology over the long term, which we expect will translate to sustained growth. We are investing significant resources in:

•Transforming the workplace to deliver new, modern, modular business applications, drive deeper insights, and improve how people communicate, collaborate, learn, work, and interact with one another. •Building and running cloud-based services in ways that utilize ubiquitous computing to unleash new experiences and opportunities for businesses and individuals. •Applying AI and ambient intelligence to drive insights, revolutionize many types of work and business processes, and provide substantive productivity gains using Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents. •Providing training on generative AI and greater access to digital learning and resources through skilling programs and initiatives, grants, and LinkedIn learning pathways. •Inventing new gaming experiences that bring people together around their shared love for games on any device and pushing the boundaries of innovation with console and PC gaming. •Leveraging Windows to fuel our cloud business, grow our share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with our services like Microsoft Edge, Bing, Copilot, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Consumer, Xbox Game Pass, and more. •Tackling security from all angles with our integrated, end-to-end solutions spanning security, compliance, identity, and management, across all clouds and platforms. Our future growth depends on our ability to transcend current product category definitions, business models, and sales motions. Commitment to Sustainability

Microsoft is committed to sustainability and our approach to addressing climate change starts with the sustainability of our own business. In 2020, we announced goals to become a carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste company by 2030. Since announcing these goals, we have made meaningful progress while having seen major changes in both the technology sector and in our understanding of what it will take to meet our goals.

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在加大對 AWS 基礎設施與生成式 AI 的資本投入，透過擴大雲端服務、增聘技術人員以及對 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 等 AI 公司的股權與融資安排，以確保長期的 AI 能力與雲端競爭優勢【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】。

- **整體基礎設施與 AI 投資方向**：Amazon 表示未來會持續提升技術與基礎設施支出，這包括擴充 AWS 服務、支援人工智慧與機器學習計畫，並預期短期自由現金流會因基礎設施與員工增長而受壓【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】。公司強調投資效率，聚焦於 AWS、產品與服務類別的擴張，以及提升客戶體驗與營運效率的基礎設施【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】。

- **AWS 服務範圍**：AWS 被描述為提供「即時技術服務」的廣泛組合，涵蓋計算、儲存、資料庫、分析與機器學習等，供各類開發者與企業使用【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】。

- **與 Anthropic 的股權投資**：在 2026 年第一季，Amazon 向 Anthropic 投入約 **5.0 億美元** 的非投票優先股【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。同時，Amazon 與 Anthropic 簽訂了商業安排，允許在達成特定計算容量里程碑時，根據該安排提供最高 **20.0 億美元** 的融資設施，該設施在 Anthropic 完成首次公開發行或直接上市後 30 個月內到期【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。此外，Amazon 擁有額外 **5.0 億美元** 的選擇權，可在未來的股權融資中投資於 Anthropic，若行使則會減少可用於融資設施的金額【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。

- **與 OpenAI 的投資**：Amazon 於 2026 年第一季向 OpenAI 的 C 系列優先股投入 **15.0 億美元**，並簽署了承諾購買額外 **35.0 億美元**（稱為「承諾金額」）的協議，允許在 OpenAI 達成特定里程碑或完成上市交易時購買剩餘股份【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。

- **投資目的與預期**：上述投資與融資安排被描述為支援 Amazon 的 AI 與機器學習長期增長，並透過持有優先股與可轉換票據等工具，讓公司在 AI 技術與算力供應上保持戰略性參與與財務回報的潛在分享【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。

records.answer:
Amazon is currently subject to multiple government investigations that allege its e‑commerce platform, Prime membership program, and AWS cloud services may violate competition, antitrust or consumer‑protection laws, and it also faces related privacy, data‑use and tax inquiries that could increase compliance costs and expose it to fines or other penalties. [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108] [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156] [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #113]

**Regulatory and antitrust exposure**

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 把 Gemini AI 直接嵌入到搜尋以及多個核心產品中，讓這些服務能即時使用其多模態理解、推理與生成能力【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  

- **搜尋（Search）**：在 2025 年的 10‑K 中，Alphabet 表示所有使用 Gemini 模型的產品皆包括搜尋，透過 Gemini 3 的先進多模態與推理功能，提升搜尋結果的理解深度與互動體驗【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **Gemini App**：同一段落說明 Gemini 3 已被整合至 Gemini App，提供使用者在產品生態系中使用 AI 代理與生成式功能【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **Google Workspace（Gmail、Docs、Sheets 等）**：在 Google Cloud 相關說明中，Gemini for Google Workspace 被列為將 AI 代理帶入 Gmail、Docs、Sheets 等生產力工具，協助使用者撰寫、組織、視覺化與加速工作流程【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- **企業客戶（Gemini Enterprise）**：Alphabet 於其雲端服務說明中指出 Gemini Enterprise 為團隊提供 AI 代理平台，讓員工可在安全環境中使用 Google AI，提升工作自動化與決策效率【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- **Google Cloud 產品套件**：在 2025 年 10‑K 的雲端服務章節，提到 Google Cloud 為客戶提供 Gemini Enterprise 與 Gemini for Google Workspace 兩項解決方案，將 Gemini AI 作為基礎基礎設施與平台服務的一部分【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #134】。  

總結來說，Google 透過在搜尋、Gemini App、Google Workspace 以及企業雲端服務（Gemini Enterprise）中嵌入 Gemini AI，讓這些核心產品能即時利用其多模態、推理與生成能力，形成跨產品的 AI 生態系統。

records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google Search 透過加入 **AI Overviews** 與 **AI Mode**，讓使用者可以以更自然的語句提出問題，並得到更完整、具多模態推理的回應，以因應生成式 AI 對搜尋體驗的衝擊【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  

- **AI Overviews** 讓使用者「問 Google 任何事」時，直接得到一段有幫助的回覆，提升查詢的即時性與資訊取得的便利性【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- **AI Mode** 則允許使用者提出更細緻、需多步驟推理的問題，這類問題過去可能需要多次搜尋才能得到答案，現在可藉由 Gemini 的先進推理與多模態能力一次回應【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  

這兩項功能屬於 Alphabet 在 2025 年持續擴大的 AI 產品與服務版圖，公司在開發新功能時先聚焦使用者體驗，之後再考慮貨幣化方式，因而可能改變過去以廣告為主的收入結構與利潤走向【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289】。同時，Alphabet 也指出在 AI 產品與服務領域面臨來自其他開發者與供應商的激烈競爭，這些競爭因素將影響其營收與毛利率走勢【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289】。

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
META 的长期愿景是通过 AI、可穿戴设备以及虚拟/增强现实技术，构建下一代计算平台——即公司所称的“元宇宙”[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72]。  

- **愿景与战略方向**：自 2021 年起，META 将业务重点转向帮助实现元宇宙，并将创新聚焦在人工智能、可穿戴设备和新型交互界面上，视其为一个复杂且长期演进的项目，需要开发新兴技术、持续投入基础设施，并在隐私、安全、监管等方面与合作伙伴共同推进[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。  

- **AI 投资**：META 正在加大对 AI 模型研发与训练的投入，并计划继续提升此类支出，以支撑其平台和技术的演进[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]。这些大规模的 Reality Labs 投资已导致 2025 财年整体营业利润下降约 191.9 亿美元，且预计 2026 财年的 Reality Labs 运营亏损将与 2025 类似[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]。  

- **Reality Labs 费用分配**：在 2026 财年，META 预计将约 70% 的 Reality Labs 运营费用用于可穿戴设备业务，剩余约 30% 用于 VR 与 Horizon（元宇宙内容平台）项目[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。  

- **具体产品路线**：在可穿戴领域，META 已推出搭载 AI 助手的 Ray‑Ban Meta 与 Oakley Meta 眼镜，并在 2024 年展示了 Orion 原型——具备行业领先视场的真 AR 眼镜；2025 年进一步推出了集显示屏于镜片的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display，配合使用肌电信号控制的 Meta Neural Band 手环[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。在 VR 方面，META 继续销售 Meta Quest 设备并通过 Horizon Store 提供软件与内容，以实现沉浸式社交、游戏、健身等体验[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 主要靠在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 以及第三方行動應用上，以「每千次曝光」或「每次使用者行動」的方式出售廣告，並在廣告被展示或使用者完成所購買的行動時即確認營收；同時，Meta AI 以助理形式嵌入其各個 App，協助內容排序、推薦、廣告工具以及讓使用者更容易學習、創作與連結。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311] [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]  

- **廣告獲利模式**：Meta 幾乎全部收入來源於廣告，廣告產品顯示在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 以及第三方行動應用上；廣告收入依「展示次數」或「使用者完成的點擊／其他行動」計價，並在廣告實際被交付或使用者執行行動的會計期間內確認收入。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]  
- **平均廣告單價**：Meta 以「總廣告收入 ÷ 交付的廣告數量」計算每則廣告的平均價格，這一指標不受廣告客戶的具體目標（如曝光或行動）影響。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]  
- **Meta AI 在 App 中的角色**：Meta AI 是一個跨平台的助理，於 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 等應用以及獨立應用、AI 眼鏡與網路上提供服務，旨在協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容並與他人互動。[META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]  
- **AI 對產品與廣告的支援**：Meta 投資的 AI 技術用於內容排序、推薦引擎、廣告主工具、生成式 AI 體驗，以及提升產品開發與生產力的內部工具，從而增強使用者體驗並提升廣告效能。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]  

因此，Meta 透過以曝光或行動為基礎的廣告銷售模式創造大部分營收，同時利用 Meta AI 助理在其應用內提升內容發現、廣告工具與使用者互動功能。

Components of Results of Operations

Revenue

Family of Apps (FoA)

Advertising. We generate substantially all of our revenue from advertising. Our advertising revenue is generated by displaying ad products on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and third-party mobile applications. Marketers pay for ad products either directly or through their relationships with advertising agencies or resellers, based on the number of impressions delivered or the number of actions, such as clicks, taken by users. We recognize revenue from the display of impression-based ads in the contracted period in which the impressions are delivered. Impressions are considered delivered when an ad is displayed to a user. We recognize revenue from the delivery of action-based ads in the period in which a user takes the action the marketer contracted for. The number of ads we show is subject to methodological changes as we continue to evolve our ads business and the structure of our ads products. In particular, the ads we show may vary by product (for example, our video and Reels products are not currently monetized at the same rate as our Feed or Stories products), and from time to time we increase or decrease the number or frequency of ads we show as part of our product and monetization strategies. We calculate average price per ad as total advertising revenue divided by the number of ads delivered, representing the average price paid per ad by a marketer regardless of their desired objective such as impression or action. For advertising revenue arrangements where we are not the principal, we recognize revenue on a net basis.

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）作為與競爭對手的核心差異化，是因為它將 AI‑驅動的全自動駕駛軟體嵌入每一輛交付的車輛，並透過自有的視覺神經網路、專屬推論晶片以及 OTA（空中下載）更新持續提升功能，同時以 Robotaxi 服務與廣大 Supercharger 充電網路作為支撐平台，形成一套完整的軟硬體生態系統，使其在自動駕駛領域具備明顯的競爭優勢 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

- **AI 與視覺神經網路**：Tesla 使用視覺為基礎的技術與軟體，訓練其人工神經網路，並由公司自行設計的推論晶片加速運算，這些都是其自動駕駛技術的核心基礎 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。  
- **每輛車皆為自動駕駛設計**：公司聲稱「每一輛今天交付的 Tesla 車輛皆為自動駕駛設計」，並認為其 AI 能力與持續的技術進步使其在市場上與其他汽車製造商區隔開來 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。  
- **OTA 軟體更新**：Tesla 透過空中下載（over‑the‑air）定期更新車輛軟體，持續改進自動駕駛功能與安全性，這種快速迭代的方式是其差異化的關鍵因素之一 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。  
- **FSD（Supervised）與 Robotaxi 服務**：公司將 FSD（Supervised）訂閱與 2025 年推出的 Robotaxi 服務結合，藉此打造以 AI、軟體與車隊為基礎的服務驅動商業模式，進一步鞏固其在自動駕駛領域的領先地位 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。  
- **競爭策略**：在與傳統叫車與其他自動駕駛競爭者的較量中，Tesla 依賴其 FSD（Supervised）與神經網路能力、廣布的 Supercharger 充電網路以及車載資訊娛樂系統來保持技術優勢 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。  
- **公司使命與定位**：Tesla 明確將「將 AI 帶入現實」作為核心營運目標，並以 FSD 與相關 AI 產品（如 Robotaxi）作為實現此使命的主要手段，這也是其在自動駕駛市場上與其他汽車公司區隔的根本原因 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30]。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. For purposes of this filing, use of the term “FSD (Supervised)” includes the equivalent naming convention, “FSD (Capability)” that is used in the European, Middle East and Asia-Pacific regions. In June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service, an autonomous ride-hailing platform that harnesses our technology and vehicles. We expect this service will open access to an expanded customer base as modes of transportation evolve, and, along with products such as FSD (Supervised) subscriptions, unlock the potential to advance a service-driven business model based on AI, software and fleet-based profits. Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Overview

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence (“AI”) into the real world, through products and services like Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (“Bots”) (including Optimus). We intend to leverage our current operations, in which we design, develop, manufacture, sell and lease high-performance fully electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems that increasingly deliver AI-related and enhanced software and services to our customers, to achieve that objective. We generally sell our products directly to customers, and continue to grow our global retail, service and charging footprint to accelerate the widespread adoption of our products. We emphasize performance, attractive styling and the safety of our users and workforce in the design and manufacture of our products and are continuing to develop full self-driving technology for improved safety. We also strive to lower the cost of ownership for our customers through continuous efforts to reduce manufacturing costs and by offering financial and other services tailored to our products. Our mission is building a world of amazing abundance. We believe that this mission, along with our engineering expertise, advancements in real-world AI, vertically integrated business model, and focus on user experience differentiate us from other companies. Segment Information

We operate as two reportable segments: (i) automotive and (ii) energy generation and storage. The automotive segment includes the design, development, manufacturing, sales and leasing of high-performance fully electric vehicles as well as sales of automotive regulatory credits. Additionally, the automotive segment also includes services and other, which includes sales of used vehicles, non-warranty maintenance services and collision, paid Supercharging sessions, automotive insurance business revenue, part sales and retail merchandise sales. The energy generation and storage segment includes sales, leasing, and financing of energy generation and storage products, services related to such products and sales of energy generation incentives. Our Products and Services

Automotive

We currently manufacture five different consumer vehicles – the Model 3, Y, S, X and Cybertruck. Model 3 is a four-door mid-size sedan that we designed for manufacturability with a base price for mass-market appeal. Model Y is a compact sport utility vehicle (“SUV”) built on the Model 3 platform with seating for up to seven adults. Model S is a four-door full-size sedan and Model X is a mid-size SUV with seating for up to seven adults. Model S and Model X feature the highest performance characteristics and longest ranges that we offer in a sedan and SUV, respectively. The Cybertruck is a full-size electric pickup truck with a stainless steel exterior that has the utility and strength of a truck while featuring the speed of a sports car. In 2022, we also began early production and deliveries of a commercial electric vehicle, the Tesla Semi.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] As we seek to become a top provider of autonomous solutions, we also face competition in the fields of AI and robotics. We expect our Robotaxi service to compete in this developing market, along with traditional ride-hailing and taxi services, through continued progress on our FSD (Supervised) and neural network capabilities, Supercharger network and infotainment offerings. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Systems

The market for energy storage products and services is also highly competitive, and both established and emerging companies have introduced products and services that are similar to our product portfolio or that are alternatives to the elements of our systems or software service offerings. We compete with these companies based on price, energy density, efficiency, optimization and performance. We believe that the specifications and features of our products, our strong brand and the modular, scalable nature of our energy storage products give us a competitive advantage in our markets. 10


Energy Generation Systems

The primary competitors to our energy generation business are the traditional local utility companies that supply energy to our potential customers. We compete with these traditional utility companies primarily based on price and the ease by which customers can switch to electricity generated by our energy generation systems. We also compete with solar energy companies that provide products and services similar to ours. Many solar energy companies only install solar energy systems, while others only provide financing for these installations. We believe we have a significant expansion opportunity with our offerings, including in terms of the aesthetics, superior performance and ease of installation and integration with Powerwall of our solar panels, and that the environment is increasingly conducive to the adoption of renewable energy systems. Intellectual Property

We place a strong emphasis on our innovative approach and proprietary designs which bring intrinsic value and uniqueness to our product portfolio. As part of our business, we seek to protect the underlying intellectual property rights of these innovations and designs such as with respect to patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, confidential information and other measures, including through employee and third-party nondisclosure agreements and other contractual arrangements. For example, we place a high priority on obtaining patents to provide the broadest and strongest possible protection to enable our freedom to operate our innovations and designs across all of our products and technologies as well as to protect and defend our product portfolio. We have also adopted a patent policy in which we irrevocably pledged that we will not initiate a lawsuit against any party for infringing our patents through activity relating to electric vehicles or related equipment for so long as such party is acting in good faith. We made this pledge in order to encourage the advancement of a common, rapidly-evolving platform for electric vehicles, thereby benefiting ourselves, other companies making electric vehicles and the world. Human Capital Resources 

Tesla’s ability to attract, develop and retain a talented workforce is a competitive advantage. As of December 31, 2025, our employee headcount worldwide was 134,785.

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨「激烈且日益加劇」的競爭局面，來自既有大型汽車廠商與新進電動車與自動駕駛企業的雙重壓力。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]  

- **競爭對手範圍廣泛**：許多既有與新興汽車製造商已進入或計畫進入電動車、混合動力、插電式混合動力以及全電動車市場，同時也在開發自動駕駛技術與相關軟體平台，這直接增加了 Tesla 在車輛銷售與技術領域的競爭者數量。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]  
- **各車系面臨的直接對手**：Tesla 的 Cybertruck 直接與其他皮卡車競爭；Model S 與 Model X 主要與高階轎車與豪華 SUV 競爭；Model 3 與 Model Y 則在小型至中型轎車與緊湊 SUV 市場與傳統內燃機車型以及其他電動車型爭奪市場份額。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]  
- **競爭的潛在影響**：因競爭者資源更為充足且可能在設計、生產、分銷、推廣與售後服務上取得規模與成本優勢，Tesla 可能面臨車輛單位銷量下降、價格壓力、營收短缺、客戶流失與市場佔有率下降的風險。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]  
- **能源與儲能領域的競爭**：除了車輛本身，Tesla 在能源發電與儲能業務上也遭遇其他製造商、開發商、安裝商與大型公用事業公司的競爭，這進一步擴大了其整體競爭態勢。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 在 2025 年的公司策略中，把能源生成與儲能產品視為差異化且有效管理的產品組合之一，用以推動盈利成長【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115】。  

- 這些能源產品直接借用汽車事業的元件級技術，採用模組化電池系統設計，以提升能源儲存產品的製造容量與彈性【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- 為了讓儲能系統能在電網中快速注入或吸收電力，Tesla 開發了遠端控制與調度的軟體平台，其中 Powerhub 用於分散式能源資源（如 Powerwall 虛擬電廠），而 Autobidder 則服務 Megapack 大型儲能裝置【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- 住宅太陽能板與 Solar Roof 皆與 Powerwall 整合，並使用公司自行研發的逆變器與電力電子技術，形成能源生成與儲能的完整生態系統【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- 2025 年公司已部署 46.7 GWh 的能源儲存產品，顯示該業務正快速擴張；同時，Tesla 計畫於 2026 年新增六條產線，覆蓋車輛、機器人、能源儲存與電池製造，以進一步提升產能【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115】【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- 為支援能源產品的軟體優化與電網互連功能，Tesla 正在擴建 AI 訓練叢集（Cortex）並與 Samsung 合作製造先進 AI 推論與訓練半導體，將這些計算資源應用於能源系統的即時資料處理與模型訓練【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  

綜合以上，能源生成與儲能業務不僅提供了與汽車事業技術共享的協同效應，亦透過專屬軟體平台、垂直整合的產品設計與產能擴張，成為 Tesla 追求差異化成長與長期盈利的重要組成部分。

records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 2025 年的 10‑K 中承認，儘管仍是全球智慧型手機、個人電腦與平板電腦市場的參與者，但其在這些領域僅佔「少數」市場份額，且面臨來自資金充沛、技術成熟且具規模優勢的競爭者的激烈價格與產品壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。

- **智慧型手機（iPhone）**：Apple 強調競爭者擁有「龐大的客戶基礎」與「低價、低利潤」的產品策略，甚至有些公司能以「幾乎不賺錢」或「虧損」的方式出售手機，對 iPhone 的價格與毛利形成下行壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。此外，競爭者會「模仿 Apple 的產品功能與整合方式」以及「協同提供整合解決方案」，進一步加劇市場競爭【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。

- **個人電腦（Mac）**：在 PC 市場，Apple 同樣指出競爭者具備「顯著的技術、行銷、分銷與其他資源」，且透過「大規模硬體與軟體產品線」與「低價策略」來爭奪市場份額，導致 Apple 必須持續創新以維持相對的價格與性能優勢【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。

- **平板電腦（iPad）**：平板市場的競爭情形與手機、PC 類似，競爭者利用「廣泛的產品線」與「低價」來吸引消費者，Apple 必須在「設計、技術創新與服務生態系」上保持領先，才能抵禦價格敏感的市場壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。

- **整體競爭環境**：Apple 進一步說明，市場特徵包括「激烈的價格競爭、毛利率下行壓力、產品壽命短、快速的技術採用」以及競爭者「透過模仿與侵害智慧財產權」的行為，這些因素共同削弱了 Apple 的定價能力與毛利表現【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #23】。

- **市場佔有率**：文件明確指出 Apple 在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置市場僅持有「少數」的市場佔有率，暗示其相對於主要競爭者的規模仍屬較小【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。

總結來說，Apple 在 10‑K 中描述自己在手機、PC、平板三大核心市場僅佔少數份額，且必須面對資金充足、成本結構低廉且善於模仿與價格戰的競爭者所帶來的持續壓力。

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 透過「讓開發者感受到在 iOS、macOS 等平台上開發能帶來較高收益與成長潛力」來建立與 Android、Windows 等競爭平台的黏著度，同時藉由持續提供具吸引力的軟體體驗與保留關鍵人才來維持生態系的活力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  

- **感知收益與成長機會**：Apple 認為開發者是否持續投入，取決於相較於 Android（手機與平板）與 Windows（個人電腦）等平台的「預期收入、未來成長與開發成本」等因素【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  
- **市場佔有率的雙刃劍**：由於 Apple 在全球智慧手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置的市場佔有率較低，開發者往往更傾向於資源較大的 Android 與 Windows 平台，這會削弱開發者對 Apple 生態系的黏著度【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  
- **應用程式品質與可用性**：Apple 強調必須持續提供「具吸引力且創新的軟體應用」才能避免因開發者轉向競爭平台而導致應用程式品質下降，進而影響使用者體驗與需求【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  
- **人才與文化保留**：Apple 的成功亦仰賴「高技能員工」與「獨特且具包容性的企業文化」來持續產出優質的開發工具與平台支援，確保開發者在技術與支援層面得到足夠資源【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  
- **快速技術變化的挑戰**：因產品與作業系統更新速度快，若開發者無法跟上變化，可能無法充分利用新功能，進而降低對 Apple 平台的投入意願【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  

綜合以上，Apple 透�過提升開發者的預期收益、提供高品質且持續創新的應用環境、以及保留關鍵技術人才，來增強相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的開發者黏著度；但其較低的市場佔有率仍是必須持續克服的挑戰。

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS

Note 1. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies

Nature of Operations

Google was incorporated in California in September 1998 and re-incorporated in the State of Delaware in August 2003. In 2015, we implemented a holding company reorganization, and as a result, Alphabet Inc. ("Alphabet") became the successor issuer to Google. We generate revenues by delivering relevant, cost-effective online advertising; cloud-based solutions that provide enterprise customers of all sizes with infrastructure, platform services, and applications; and sales of other products and services, such as fees received for subscription-based products, apps and in-app purchases, and devices. Basis of Consolidation

The consolidated financial statements of Alphabet include the accounts of Alphabet and entities consolidated under the variable interest and voting models. Intercompany balances and transactions have been eliminated. Use of Estimates

Preparation of consolidated financial statements in conformity with GAAP requires us to make estimates and assumptions that affect the amounts reported and disclosed in the financial statements and the accompanying notes. Actual results could differ materially from these estimates due to uncertainties. On an ongoing basis, we evaluate our estimates, including those related to the allowance for credit losses; contingent liabilities; fair values of financial instruments and goodwill; income taxes; inventory; and useful lives of property and equipment, among others. We base our estimates on assumptions, both historical and forward looking, that are believed to be reasonable, and the results of which form the basis for making judgments about the carrying values of assets and liabilities. Revenue Recognition

Revenues are recognized when control of the promised goods or services is transferred to our customers, and the collectibility of an amount that we expect in exchange for those goods or services is probable. Sales and other similar taxes are excluded from revenues. Google Advertising

Google advertising revenues consist of revenues from:

•Google Search and other properties, including revenues from traffic generated by search distribution partners who use Google.com as their default search in browsers, toolbars, etc. and other Google owned and operated properties like Gmail, Google Maps, and Google Play;

•YouTube properties; and

•Google Network properties, including revenues from Google Network properties participating in AdMob, AdSense, and Google Ad Manager. Our customers generally purchase advertising inventory through Google Ads, Google Ad Manager, Google Display & Video 360, and Google Marketing Platform, among others. We offer advertising by delivering both performance and brand advertising. We recognize revenues for performance advertising when a user engages with the advertisement. For brand advertising, we recognize revenues when the ad is displayed, or a user views the ad. For ads placed on Google Network properties, we evaluate whether we are the principal (i.e., report revenues on a gross basis) or agent (i.e., report revenues on a net basis). Generally, we report advertising revenues for ads placed on Google Network properties on a gross basis, that is, the amounts billed to our customers are recorded as revenues, and amounts paid to Google Network partners are recorded as cost of revenues. Where we are the principal, we control the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers. Our control is evidenced by our sole ability to monetize the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers and is further supported by us being primarily responsible to our customers and having a level of discretion in establishing pricing. Google Subscriptions, Platforms, and Devices

Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices revenues consist of revenues from:

53. Alphabet Inc. •consumer subscriptions, which primarily include revenues from YouTube services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, and NFL Sunday Ticket, as well as Google One, which offers access to our most capable Gemini models;

•platforms, which primarily include revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases;

•devices, which primarily include sales of the Pixel family of devices; and

•other products and services. Subscription revenues are recognized ratably over the period of the subscription, primarily monthly. We report revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases on a net basis because our performance obligation is to facilitate a transaction between app developers and end users for which we earn a service fee. Google Cloud

Google Cloud revenues consist of revenues from:

•Google Cloud Platform primarily generates consumption-based fees and subscriptions for infrastructure, platform, and other services. These services provide access to solutions such as AI offerings including our enterprise AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini Enterprise; cybersecurity offerings; and data and analytics solutions;

•Google Workspace includes subscriptions for cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Gmail, Docs, Calendar, Drive, and Meet, with integrated features like Gemini for Google Workspace; and

•other enterprise services. Our cloud services are generally provided on either a consumption or subscription basis and may have contract terms longer than a year.

For additional information, including how we account for our investments and factors that can drive fluctuations in the value of our investments, see Note 1 and Note 3 of the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements included in Item 8 as well as Item 7A Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Provision for Income Taxes 

Provision for income taxes represents the estimated amount of federal, state, and foreign income taxes incurred in the US and the many jurisdictions in which we operate. The provision includes the effect of reserve provisions and changes to reserves that are considered appropriate as well as the related net interest and penalties.

Expanded AI Offerings in our Products and Services: The continuing evolution of the online world has contributed to the growth of our business. We expect that this evolution, including user engagement with AI products and services, will continue to benefit our business and our revenues. As we continue to incorporate AI into our products and services, such as with AI Overviews and AI Mode in Search, and with enterprise AI solutions on our Google Cloud Platform, we may monetize differently than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings which could affect revenue growth rates and margin trends. The margins on these revenues vary significantly and are generally lower than the margins on our advertising revenues. These agreements allow customers to acquire monthly or annual subscriptions for cloud-based services. Microsoft Products and Services Agreement 

Microsoft Products and Services Agreements are designed for medium and large organizations that want to license cloud services and on-premises software as needed, with no organization-wide commitment, under a single, non-expiring agreement. Organizations purchase perpetual licenses or subscribe to licenses. SA is optional for customers that purchase perpetual licenses. Open Value

Open Value agreements are a simple, cost-effective way to acquire the latest Microsoft technology. These agreements are designed for small and medium organizations that want to license cloud services and on-premises software over a three-year period. Under Open Value agreements, organizations can elect to purchase perpetual licenses or subscribe to licenses and SA is included. Select Plus 

A Select Plus agreement is designed for government and academic organizations to acquire on-premises licenses at any affiliate or department level, while realizing advantages as one organization. Organizations purchase perpetual licenses and SA is optional. Partner Programs 

The Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider Program offers customers an easy way to license the cloud services they need in combination with the value-added services offered by their systems integrator, managed services provider, or cloud reseller partner. Partners in this program can easily package their own products and services to directly provision, manage, and support their customer subscriptions. The Microsoft Services Provider License Agreement allows hosting service providers and independent software vendors who want to license eligible Microsoft software products to provide hosted applications and software services to their end customers. Partners license software over a three-year period and are billed monthly based on units licensed. The Independent Software Vendor Royalty Program enables partners to integrate Microsoft products into other applications and then license the unified business solution to their end users. records.answer:
Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門在最新的三個月（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日）營收基本持平，僅下降約 1% 至 **132.0 億美元**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。  

- **Windows 與 Devices**：Windows OEM 收入上升 2%（OEM 本身增長 8%），Devices 營收則因庫存仍高而出現下降，整體 Windows 與 Devices 收入僅略有提升【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111】。  
- **Gaming**：Xbox 硬體收入大幅下跌 31%，Xbox 內容與服務收入下降 3%，導致 Gaming 營收減少 11 億美元或約 6%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111】。  
- **Search Advertising**：Search 廣告收入增加 10%，貢獻約 10 億美元的正向增長【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111】。  

因此，Windows OEM 的小幅增長與 Devices 的下降相互抵消，Gaming 的大幅下滑又被 Search Advertising 的增長所部分抵銷，最終使 More Personal Computing 的總營收僅呈現微幅下降。

AWS 的營業利益在最新一季（2026 Q1）主要是因為客戶使用量提升帶來的銷售增長，以及為支撐這波增長而加大了技術與基礎建設的投資，儘管匯率變動對營業利益產生了負面影響【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79】。  

- 2026 Q1 AWS 營業利益從 115.5 億美元（2025 Q1）提升至 141.6 億美元，增幅約 22.6%【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79】。  
- 同期 AWS 銷售額成長 28%，主要來源於客戶使用量的提升，僅因長期合約的價格調整而略有抵消【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #75】。  
- 營業利益的提升「主要因為銷售增加，部分被技術基礎建設支出所抵消」，而這些支出是為了支撐 AWS 業務的持續擴張【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79】。  
- 匯率變動對 2026 Q1 的 AWS 營業利益產生了約 –3.39 億美元的負面影響【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79】。  

因此，AWS 營業利益的成長核心驅動力是「客戶使用量帶動的銷售增長」與「為支撐增長所投入的技術與基礎建設」，而匯率因素則稍微削弱了這一正面效應。

Cost of sales primarily consists of the purchase price of consumer products, inbound and outbound shipping costs, including costs related to sortation and delivery centers and where we are the transportation service provider, and digital media content costs where we record revenue gross, including video and music. Fulfillment

Fulfillment costs primarily consist of those costs incurred in operating and staffing our North America and International fulfillment centers, physical stores, and customer service centers and payment processing costs. While AWS payment processing and related transaction costs are included in “Fulfillment,” AWS costs are primarily classified as “Technology and infrastructure.” Fulfillment costs as a percentage of net sales may vary due to several factors, such as payment processing and related transaction costs, our level of productivity and accuracy, changes in volume, size, and weight of units received and fulfilled, the extent to which third-party sellers utilize Fulfillment by Amazon services, timing of fulfillment network and physical store expansion, the extent we utilize fulfillment services provided by third parties, mix of products and services sold, and our ability to affect customer service contacts per unit by implementing improvements in our operations and enhancements to our customer self-service features. Additionally, sales by our sellers have higher payment processing and related transaction costs as a percentage of net sales compared to our retail sales because payment processing costs are based on the gross purchase price of underlying transactions.

records.query: Google Cloud 部門最新一季的營收成長多少？
records.answer:
Google Cloud 的營收在最新一季（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的三個月）較去年同期大幅成長約 **82 %**，即收入從 135. 億美元提升至 247. 億美元，增幅約 111 億美元【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #43】、【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47】。  

- 2025 年同季 Google Cloud 營收為 **13,624 百萬美元**；2026 年同季為 **24,768 百萬美元**，兩者差額為 **11,144 百萬美元**（即約 111 億美元）【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47】。  
- 這一增長主要受 Google Cloud Platform 基礎設施與平台服務需求的提升驅動，並在 2026 年第二季開始確認 TPU 系統銷售收入【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47】。

records.query: Google 收購 Wiz 花了多少錢？這如何影響 Google Cloud 部門？
records.answer:
Google 於 2026 年 3 月 11 日完成對雲端安全公司 Wiz 的收購，總成交金額為 **295 億美元**（扣除後價格）【GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77】。

- 這筆收購的購買價格分配為：**83 億美元的無形資產**、**227.05 億美元的商譽**，以及**約 15.38 億美元的淨負債**（負債抵減後的淨額為 –15.38 億美元）【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94】。  
- 收購完成後，Wiz 的財務結果已被合併入 Alphabet 的合併財務報表，且歸屬於 **Google Cloud 部門**【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94】。  
- 商譽已在 Google Cloud 部門的資產負債表中列示，主要反映預期的協同效應【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94】。  
- Alphabet 表示，此次收購是 **Google Cloud 投資以加速多雲與 AI 驅動的安全能力**，顯示該部門將透過 Wiz 的技術提升其安全產品組合【GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77】。  

因此，收購金額為 295 億美元，並透過將無形資產與商譽納入 Google Cloud 的資產負債表，以及將 Wiz 的營運結果合併入該部門的財務報表，直接影響了 Google Cloud 的資產結構與未來的安全服務布局。

Meta’s most recent quarter (the three months ended March 31 2026) saw total revenue rise about **33 % year‑over‑year to $56.3 billion** (up from $42.3 billion in the same quarter of 2025)【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #0】.  

- The bulk of the increase came from **advertising revenue**, which grew $13.63 billion, or **33 %**, versus the prior‑year quarter【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】.  
- Advertising growth was driven by two key factors:  
  1. **Higher ad impressions** – deliveries rose 19 % YoY, expanding the inventory available for sale【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】.  
  2. **Higher average price per ad** – the average price per ad rose 12 % YoY, reflecting stronger demand and improved targeting/measurement tools【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】.  
- **Non‑advertising (FoA) revenue** also contributed, jumping $375 million, or **74 %**, mainly from paid WhatsApp messaging and Meta Verified subscriptions【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】.  
- **Reality Labs (RL) revenue** slipped slightly (down 2 %), offsetting a small portion of the overall growth【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】.  

Thus, Meta’s Q1 2026 revenue grew roughly one‑third, primarily powered by a surge in ad impressions and higher ad pricing, with additional support from fast‑growing subscription‑based services.

Trends in Our Revenue by User Geography 

We calculate our revenue by user geography based on our estimate of the geography in which ad impressions are delivered, virtual and digital goods are purchased, or consumer hardware products are shipped. The geography of our users affects our revenue and financial results. Our revenue in regions such as United States & Canada and Europe is relatively higher primarily due to the size and maturity of those online and mobile advertising markets, and ad impression growth is primarily in geographies that monetize at lower rates, such as Asia-Pacific. In the first quarter of 2026, revenue increased by 29% in United States & Canada, 39% in Europe, 29% in Asia-Pacific, and 40% in Rest of World, in each case relative to the same period in 2025. -

Our revenue by user geography in the charts above is geographically apportioned based on our estimation of the geographic location of our users when they perform a revenue-generating activity.

[META 10-Q period 202603] Advertising

Advertising revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 increased $13.63 billion, or 33%, compared to the same period in 2025, due to increases in ad impressions delivered and average price per ad. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, ad impressions delivered increased by 19%, year-over-year, as compared with an increase of 5% in the same period in 2025. Ad impressions delivered during the three months ended March 31, 2026 grew in all regions, especially in Asia-Pacific, which was driven by increases in users and their engagement as well as the frequency of ads shown on our products. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, the average price per ad increased by 12%, year-over-year, as compared with an increase of 10% in the same period in 2025. The increase in average price per ad in the three months ended March 31, 2026 was driven by an increase in advertising demand, which we believe is mostly due to ongoing improvements to our ad performance from our ad targeting and measurement tools, and a favorable foreign currency exchange impact. This increase was partially offset by a higher number of ad impressions delivered, especially in geographies and in products, such as Reels, that monetize at lower rates. Other factors are discussed in the section entitled "—Executive Overview of First Quarter Results." In addition, the online commerce vertical was the largest contributor to the increase in advertising revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. We anticipate that future advertising revenue will be driven by a combination of price and ad impressions delivered. Other revenue

FoA other revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 increased $375 million, or 74%, compared to the same period in 2025. The increase was mostly driven by paid messaging from WhatsApp and Meta Verified subscriptions. Reality Labs

RL revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 decreased $10 million, or 2%, compared to the same period in 2025. The decrease was driven by lower Meta Quest sales, offset by an increase in sales of AI glasses. Foreign Exchange Impact on Revenue

Changes in foreign exchange rates had a favorable impact on our revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. - **收入變化**：2027 財年第一季（截至 2026‑04‑26）的中國（含香港）客戶收入為 **4,550 百萬美元**；2026 財年第一季（截至 2025‑04‑27）為 **9,659 百萬美元**，形成約 **53% 的同比下降**【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #36】。  
- **出貨情況**：公司說明在 2027 財年第一季 **未向中國出貨 Data Center Hopper 產品**，而在 2026 財年第一季則出貨約 **46 億美元**（即 $4.6 B）【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47】。  

因此，從收入與具體產品出貨兩個角度看，NVIDIA 本季在中國的資料中心晶片業務均出現大幅縮減。

records.query: Tesla 能源生成與儲能業務最新一季營收表現如何？
records.answer:
Tesla 能源生成與儲能業務在最新的2026年第二季（截至2026‑06‑30）營收為 **31.39 億美元**【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0】。  

- 這一季的能源生成與儲能營收為 $3,139 百萬，較2025年同季的 $2,789 百萬提升約 12.6 %【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #28】。  
- 該項目在總營收 $28,236 百萬中佔約 11.1 %（$3,139 ÷ $28,236）【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0】。  

因此，Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在最新一季持續增長，營收達到約 31.4 億美元。

records.answer:
Tesla’s automotive‑sales revenue grew **27 % year‑over‑year in the most recent quarter, rising by $4.22 billion to $20.0 billion for the three months ended June 30 2026**【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #75】.

We introduced our first Tensor Core GPU in 2017, built from the ground-up for the new era of AI, and our first autonomous driving system-on-chips, or SoC, in 2018. Our acquisition of Mellanox in 2020 expanded our offerings to include networking, enabled our platforms to be data center scale, and led to the introduction of a new processor class – the data processing unit, or DPU. Over the past 5 years, we have built full software stacks that run on top of our GPUs and CUDA to bring AI to the world’s largest industries, including NVIDIA DRIVE stack for autonomous driving, Clara for healthcare, Omniverse for physical AI applications, and NVIDIA AI Enterprise software – essentially an operating system for enterprise AI applications. records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
AI 幾乎全部依賴 NVIDIA，是因為它提供了從硬體到軟體、從晶片到完整平台的全套加速運算生態，且已被數百萬開發者、所有主要雲端服務商以及絕大多數超級電腦採用。  

- NVIDIA 以 **CUDA** 為核心的軟體堆疊讓所有 GPU 都能被廣泛程式化，全球已有 **超過 7.5 百萬開發者** 使用 CUDA 及其他工具來部署 AI 應用，形成龐大且持續擴張的生態系統【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- 公司同時提供 **完整的端到端 AI 平台**：包括 GPU、CPU（Grace）與 DPU、互聯網路、系統與軟體套件（如 NVIDIA AI Enterprise、NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints），讓客戶在同一平台上完成模型訓練與推論【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- 這套平台已被 **所有主要雲端服務提供商（CSP）**、AI 模型製造商與企業廣泛採用，並支援 **超過 6,000 種應用**，涵蓋金融、醫療、交通、氣候模擬等多個產業【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #22】。  
- 在高效能運算領域，NVIDIA 的 GPU 與網路技術 **驅動了全球 TOP500 超級電腦的超過 78%**，其中 9 台位列 Green500 前十，顯示其在極致運算規模上的領先地位【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #22】。  
- NVIDIA 透過 **Mellanox 收購** 擴展至資料中心互聯與 DPU，並在 2023 年推出首款資料中心 CPU Grace，2024 年推出 Blackwell 架構，形成硬體與軟體的深度共設，進一步鞏固其在 AI 訓練與推論的性能優勢【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。  
- 公司還建立了 **廣泛的合作與教育網絡**：包括與數百所大學、數萬家新創公司（Inception 計畫）以及 Deep Learning Institute 的培訓，持續培養新一代 AI 開發者，提升平台黏著度【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- 這些技術與生態的結合，使得競爭者難以在短時間內同時提供同等規模的硬體效能、成熟的軟體堆疊與廣大的開發者社群，因而「學不來」或無法快速取代 NVIDIA 在 AI 基礎設施中的核心位置。

Microsoft 透過在 Microsoft 365 內加入 AI‑驅動的功能（例如 Microsoft 365 Copilot）以及各種 AI‑增強工具與情境，將人工智慧直接嵌入 Office 相關的產品與服務中【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。

- 產品與服務的 AI 整合方式包括「新增 AI‑enabled 工具、功能與 agentic 情境」到核心產品與服務，藉此提升使用者體驗與價值，並支撐 Microsoft 365 商業版與消費者版的成長【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- 在 LinkedIn 與 Dynamics 產品線上，Microsoft 亦提供 AI‑enabled 洞察與服務，顯示其 AI 佈局已跨越多個平台與應用【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  

因此，Microsoft 主要是透過在 Microsoft 365（包含 Office）中加入 AI‑powered 的 Copilot 以及其他 AI 功能，將人工智慧嵌入到日常的生產力工具與相關服務裡。

Growth depends on our ability to reach new users in new markets such as frontline workers, small and medium businesses, and growth markets, as well as add AI-enabled tools, features, and agentic scenarios to our core product and service offerings across communication, collaboration, analytics, security, compliance, and other AI business productivity categories. Microsoft 365 Commercial revenue is mainly affected by a combination of continued installed base growth and average revenue per user expansion, as well as the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365. Microsoft 365 Consumer Products and Cloud Services

Microsoft 365 Consumer is designed to increase personal productivity and creativity through a range of products and services. Growth depends on our ability to reach new users, add value to our core product set with new features including AI tools, and continue to expand our product and service offerings into new markets. Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue and Office Consumer products revenue is mainly affected by the percentage of customers that buy Office with their new devices and the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions. Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue is also affected by the demand for communication and storage through Outlook.com and OneDrive, which is largely driven by subscriptions and advertising. LinkedIn

LinkedIn connects the world’s professionals to make them more productive and successful and transforms the way companies hire, market, sell, and learn. In addition to LinkedIn’s free services, LinkedIn offers monetized solutions designed to offer AI-enabled insights and productivity: Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Premium Subscriptions, and Sales Solutions. Growth will depend on our ability to increase LinkedIn member engagement on the platform and our ability to continue offering insight and AI-enabled services that provide value for our members and customers. LinkedIn revenue is mainly affected by demand from enterprises and professionals for subscriptions to Talent Solutions, Sales Solutions, and Premium Subscriptions offerings, as well as member engagement and the quality of the sponsored content delivered to those members to drive Marketing Solutions. Dynamics Products and Cloud Services

Dynamics provides cloud-based and on-premises business solutions for financial management, enterprise resource planning (“ERP”), customer relationship management (“CRM”), and supply chain management, as well as agentic AI and other low code application development platforms, for small and medium businesses, large organizations, and divisions of global enterprises. Dynamics revenue is driven by the number of users licensed and applications consumed, expansion of average revenue per user, and the continued shift to Dynamics 365, a unified set of cloud-based intelligent business applications, including our low code development platforms, such as Power Apps and Power Automate. Competition

Competitors to Office include software and global application vendors, web-based and mobile application companies, AI-first application companies, as well as local application developers.

Alphabet Inc. Our products and services have come a long way since the company was founded more than 25 years ago. While Google Search started as a way to find web pages, organized into ten blue links, we have driven technical advancements and product innovations that have transformed Google Search into a dynamic, multimodal experience. Large language models have made it possible to express more natural language queries, vastly improving the types of questions users can ask, and the quality of results.
